query: Across Type of Traveller and Class, which review themes are associated with higher vs. lower Overall Rating?

per_column.name: seat_comfort_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Binary theme-presence flag with well-balanced classes (485/415); reviews can be segmented on whether seat comfort was raised and mean Overall Rating compared. Directly matches the query's review-theme framing.

per_column.name: staff_service_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary theme flag (740/160); groupable and comparable against rating, a core review theme.

per_column.name: food_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Clean binary theme presence (599/301); supports segmented comparison of ratings.

per_column.name: entertainment_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Balanced binary theme flag (532/368); interpretable segmentation dimension.

per_column.name: value_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Binary theme flag (728/172); somewhat imbalanced but the minority class is large enough for meaningful comparison.

per_column.name: punctuality_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Binary theme flag (648/252); a distinct, interpretable theme not already in original columns, well suited for grouping.

per_column.name: cleanliness_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Binary theme flag (783/117); minority class small but still ~117 rows, allowing an interpretable comparison of a new theme.

per_column.name: review_length
per_column.rationale: Raw character count is a generic, near-continuous metadata feature with highly fragmented values (mostly counts of 3-6); not a review theme and not naturally categorized, so it yields opaque rather than interpretable segmentation.

per_column.name: detailed_negative_review
per_column.rationale: Binary flag (695/205) capturing sentiment-length interaction; interpretable and groupable, plausibly correlated with rating, though it conflates length with sentiment.

per_column.name: detailed_positive_review
per_column.rationale: Binary flag (493/407), well balanced; interpretable segmentation associable with rating.

per_column.name: dominant_theme
per_column.rationale: Single categorical label of the leading theme with clear, well-separated categories; excellent EDA segmentation dimension directly aligned with the query, though top-heavy toward seat_comfort/staff_service.

per_column.name: theme_count
per_column.rationale: Small-integer ordinal (0-7) of how many themes a review raises; well-distributed and interpretable as review richness, comparable against rating.

judge.rationale: The set overwhelmingly delivers interpretable, external theme dimensions that can be grouped and cross-tabbed against Overall Rating within Type of Traveller and Class, directly realising the correlational EDA intent. The per-theme binary flags, the dominant_theme categorical, and theme_count are all well-separated and human-readable. Weaknesses: review_length is an opaque, over-fragmented metadata scale offering little interpretable segmentation, and the detailed_positive/negative flags partly conflate length with sentiment. Overall the collection strongly supports discovering interpretable theme-rating relationships, with one clear miss.
